question_prompt: Q5: Have you ever felt pressure to do any of the following?
panels: Q5: Agree to do public-facing work (like presenting, posting, or speaking) just to seem visible or impressive to others
Q5: Avoided showing vulnerability at work to protect my image
Q5: Exaggerate how busy or in-demand I am
Q5: Exaggerate my accomplishments on my LinkedIn and/or resu
Q5: Hid gaps or “failures” on my resume
Q5: I don’t feel pressure to manage or perform my professional identity
Q5: Keep up a professional persona in the work environment that I don’t relate to
